items.name: Gen Rush Squad
items.why_it_works: Built entirely from the game's most-used survivor perks: co-op gens fast, win chases when they happen, coordinate without comms, and cash in Adrenaline at the endgame.

items.name: Slowdown Stack
items.why_it_works: The four most-used killer perks in the current NightLight data, stacked together: every hook and every down chips away at generator progress, buying time even in a bad chase-heavy match.

items.name: Boon Squad
items.why_it_works: Coordinate as a team to snowball totems into a self-sufficient healing/stealth/pick-up network — less about optimal solo play, more about turning the map into a shrine crawl with your squad.
